sources.title: U.S. Holiday Archive, 2015 to 2025
notes: The page lists no date under Presidents Day for 2015 and 2016.
The page lists Veterans Day 2023 with no date: it fell on a Saturday.
For Good Friday 2015 the page gives 'Friday, April 3, 2015' and 'Early Close (12:00 Noon Eastern Time) Friday, April 3, 2015'; it is transcribed as the noon early close.

sources.title: SIFMA Holiday Recommendations 1996 - 2019 (December 2018)
notes: Dates the tables give without a year take the table's year.
The 2016 table's 'Friday, December 30, 2015' and the 2017 table's 'Friday, December 31, 2016' are both transcribed as Friday 2016-12-30, the early close before New Year's Day 2017.
The tables give each early close at 2 p.m. unless a cell names another time.
